channel.title: GloryStarPack Packaging Insights
channel.description: Practical B2B packaging procurement notes about RFQs, samples, closures, materials, decoration, compatibility and quality approval.

item.title: Cosmetic Pump and Closure Selection Guide
item.description: Choose lotion pumps, fine mist sprayers, foam pumps, droppers and fragrance crimp pumps by neck finish, formula, output and filling requirements.

item.title: Cosmetic Packaging Compatibility Testing Guide
item.description: Plan formula, leakage, dispensing, decoration and transport checks with the final bottle, closure, label and packing system before bulk approval.

item.title: Glass Bottle Sample Approval and QC Checklist
item.description: Use a production-ready checklist for bottle dimensions, capacity, neck finish, closure fit, decoration, filling-line trials and export packing.

item.title: Glass Bottle Neck Finish and Closure Guide
item.description: Match corks, bar tops, screw caps, ROPP closures, crown caps, swing tops and fragrance pumps to the exact glass bottle finish.

item.title: Custom Glass Bottle MOQ: Stock Bottle vs Custom Mold
item.description: Understand why glass bottle MOQ changes with stock status, glass color, closures, decoration and mold development before requesting a quote.

item.title: 36 New Personal Care and Grooming Packaging SKUs Added
item.description: New foam pumps, shampoo bottles, sunscreen sticks, beard oil droppers, grooming tins and molded pulp gift boxes are now grouped for faster sourcing.

item.title: Matching Refill Pouches with Reusable Bottles
item.description: A refill program works best when pouch structure, spout position, cap fit, bottle mouth size and carton packing are planned together.

item.title: How to Prepare a Useful Cosmetic Packaging RFQ
item.description: The best quote requests give suppliers enough context to recommend realistic materials, MOQ, decoration methods and sample timing.

item.title: Hotel Amenity Kits Move Toward Refill-Ready Formats
item.description: Mini bottles, clear toiletry pouches, refill pouches and paper sleeves are now often sourced as one hospitality packaging set.

item.title: Discovery Kits That Make Sample Programs Easier to Quote
item.description: Mini vials, sachets, jars and molded trays can be handled as one packaging set instead of scattered components.

item.title: PCR HDPE Bottles for Shampoo and Body Care Launches
item.description: Recycled-content HDPE bottles require attention to squeeze feel, closure fit, color consistency and decoration before bulk approval.

item.title: Color Cosmetics Buyers Ask for Component Systems, Not Single Tubes
item.description: Mascara, brow gel, lip oil and applicator matching are moving into one-stop development briefs. Review the key component, sample and approval checks before.

item.title: QC Checklist for Pumps, Caps, Droppers and Rollerballs
item.description: Fit, torque, leakage, dip tube length and formula compatibility checks should happen before approving bulk production.

item.title: Molded Pulp Inserts for Fragrance and Gift Box Projects
item.description: Paper-based inserts protect bottles, improve unboxing and reduce plastic foam in premium packaging kits. Review the key component, sample and approval checks.

item.title: When to Choose Coating, Silk Screen, Hot Stamping or Label
item.description: Decoration selection depends on material, order quantity, artwork complexity, chemical exposure and budget. Review the key component, sample and approval.
